summary: Frontend-only test of the change tracking in the admin dashboard (Pages, Articles, FAQ, Contenu produits) using Playwright on the public URL. Everything requested passed: no indicators in consultation mode; in edit mode, indicators appear only when a value really differs; 'Annuler ce changement' goes back to the LAST SAVED value, also checked after a save; indicators disappear right after a successful save; 'Enregistrer (n)' and the left-column badges count correctly; window.confirm appears for Terminer, switching item in the left list, switching admin tab and Retour à la liste (dismiss keeps the edits, accept discards them, and no prompt when nothing is pending); after a simulated 500 error on save the modified state is kept (Pages and Produits). Saving a product content change left price, status, purchasable and file unchanged (before/after API diff was empty). All real data was restored and the synthetic article was deleted.

issues: Reordering or deleting a question raises the count ('1 non enregistré') but no item shows a 'modifié' badge and there is no per-item 'Annuler ce changement'. Only 'Annuler les modifications' undoes it. Acceptable, but the user may not see what changed.
The up/down/delete buttons of the content blocks stay visible (disabled) in consultation mode. FAQ hides them (fixed={!s.editing}). Minor inconsistency.

action_items: Optional: hide the ListEditor controls in Articles consultation mode (pass fixed={!s.editing}) to match FAQ.
Optional: show a hint when the FAQ count comes only from reordering or deleting questions.
Data hygiene: product budget-couple has description 'desc T1', probably left over from an earlier test iteration; check and clean it up.
critical_code_review_comments: editTracking.useEditSession: when the saved data changes (new sig), base and draft are both reset. A background refetch that returns different data during an edit (e.g. another admin tab) would silently overwrite unsaved changes. Low risk for a single admin.
ContentPanel has no pending badge in the product list. Acceptable because the editor replaces the list, so there is nothing to show it in.
Pages save sends null when the value equals the schema default, which clears the override. Verified: the home hero_eyebrow override was removed after the restore.
seed_data_creation: Created the article 'TEST suivi modifs' (test-suivi-modifs, unpublished) and deleted it with SUPPRIMER. Temporarily changed and then restored: home hero_eyebrow, FAQ faq-1 question, budget-mensuel short_description. Verified restored via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login at /admin/login (credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Dialogs are native window.confirm, handled with page.on('dialog'). The selectors used are listed in the review request and all exist. To simulate save errors, intercept PUT/POST on **/api/admin/content/** and **/api/admin/products/** with page.route.
